title: NodeTagsReport
description: Canonical tagger-report shape (2026-07-21, the taxonomy leg of the summarizer-split direction). An Action whose report schema `$ref`s a schema under the `tags/` namespace is a TAGGER: `sm record` detects that reference (mirror of the `summaries/` detection signal) and, after the record transaction commits, merges `tags[]` into the node's sidecar `annotations.tags` through the gated `.sm` write channel (union with the existing tags, case-insensitive dedup, existing order preserved; the write-through `scan_nodes.annotations_json` mirror refreshes). The write honours the standing `allowEditSmFiles` consent: without it the tags are NOT applied (a human-mode advisory says so) while the report still records. Storage-rule note (`architecture.md` §Storage rule): applied tags land in the CURATION store because the operator's launch is delegated curation, the same rationale that lets fixers edit bodies; afterwards the tags are ordinary human-owned annotations (editable via the tags row / `core/node-set-tags`). Like every probabilistic report it extends `report-base.schema.json` (confidence + safety).

items.description: Short lowercase kebab-case topical tag, written in the language of the file's content.

tags.description: The topical tags the model infers from the node's content (2-6 recommended; 8 hard cap).
